title: Rusty Forge
body:
"A fiery forge used for processing refined materials! Creates nice and smooth bars."

Description

The Rusty Forge is the first obtainable tier of forges. It can be found and purchased at The Oak Depot. It is used to smelt refined ores/rocks (which can be done through a refinery) into forged ingots/rocks by putting them through its conveyor.

Appearance

The forge appears to be rusty (as the name may suggest) and bears a slight resemblance to the sawmill from Lumber Tycoon 2, another game of a similar genre.

Trivia

  • The forge bears a faint resemblance to the Sawmill from Lumber Tycoon 2.
  • The only ore not to increase in value if put through it is Magnetite.
